title: Map open evaluation tools
question: Which existing open tools can verify the first contribution loop?
baseline: README.md, docs/stack.md, and docs/verification.md at the checked-out commit.
resources: A laptop, Python 3.11+, and access to public documentation. No GPU.
acceptance: Cover at least three existing projects with primary source links.
For each, state license, task coverage, setup path, resource needs, and known limits.
Recommend one starting point and explain its fit with the mission.
Separate checked facts from suggestions. Do not claim an experiment was run.
checks: Manually review every cited primary source.
evidence: Time spent, tool used, and unresolved questions.
stop_conditions: No suitable licensed baseline found; report the gap.
deliverable: A research map that lets a reviewer select a first evaluation tool.
